title: 2013 HMMT November Guts Problem 15
statement: Find all real numbers \(x\) between 0 and 360 such that \(\sqrt{3} \cos 10^{\circ}=\cos 40^{\circ}+\sin x^{\circ}\).

solutions.text: \(\quad 70,110\) (need both, but order doesn't matter) Note that \(\sqrt{3}=2 \cos 30^{\circ}\), so \(\sin x^{\circ}=\) \(\cos 20^{\circ} \Longrightarrow x \in\{70,110\}\).
